evidence_classes.development: Twelve nested purged outer-development experiments on development_reused_previously_exposed data; valid for rejection only.
evidence_classes.previously_revealed_historical_audit: Existing V3 2023-07-03 onward evidence only; all horizons failed and it was not rerun for the new batch.

findings.title: Multi-day economic, benchmark, PBO, DSR, and trade-count evidence is not an executable non-overlapping path
evidence: src/hge_gold/research_experiments.py:498-505 constructs the final return matrix directly from every action row rather than build_mt5_signal_schedule.
src/hge_gold/research_experiments.py:603 labels count_nonzero(net_returns) as n_non_overlapping_trades.
For no_hurst H5/H10/H20, registered action counts are 1089/2351/2331 while a chronological one-position schedule contains 264/236/117 trades.

artifacts/research/qa/post_run_economic_overlap_audit.json acknowledges that H5/H10/H20 registered economic paths overlap and that benchmark deltas, economic confidence intervals, PBO, and DSR were not corrected.
build_mt5_signal_schedule extends busy_until when it rejects an overlapping signal, so a rejected signal incorrectly delays later eligibility; the existing unit test encodes this behavior.
risks: Registered economics and multiple-testing diagnostics cannot support promotion or profitability.
The inner no-trade margin was selected using a schedule that does not match a normal one-position replay.
findings.recommended_action: Do not alter the exhausted v1 registry. Fix the scheduler and final return-path construction, add independent schedule/trade fixtures, and preregister a separate v2 family with corrected same-schedule benchmarks, block uncertainty, PBO, and DSR.
findings.implementation_status: deferred; an honest post-run audit was implemented and preserves the rejection disposition

findings.title: No model candidate qualifies for freeze, confirmation, historical audit, or MT5
evidence: The registry contains 12 unique, hash-valid records and all decisions are reject.
The highest pooled balanced accuracy is robust_hurst_regime H20 at 0.5113 with macro-F1 0.4585 and 95% block interval [0.4725, 0.5451].
Every one of the 12 balanced-accuracy intervals includes 0.50.
No artifacts/research/candidates directory or candidate freeze exists.
risks: Any candidate, confirmation, audit, profitability, or future-OOS claim would be unsupported.
findings.recommended_action: Keep all 12 trials closed as rejected. Do not freeze a model or run confirmation/audit/MT5 for this family.

findings.title: The canonical run receipt does not make run outputs immutable or fully reproducible
evidence: run_receipt.json has no file inventory or hashes for its 62 run files, 12 prediction CSVs, or 12 model-spec JSON files.

The receipt's code_sha256 covers only src/hge_gold/research_experiments.py, not calibration.py, research_validation.py, statistics.py, features.py, targets.py, data.py, or other imported implementation files.
The current runner cannot perform a read-only deterministic replay because the nonempty registry guard aborts before computation.
The first trial in the incomplete 151330Z run is byte-identical to its canonical counterpart, which is useful partial reproducibility evidence but not a complete independent replay.
risks: Post-run artifact mutation cannot be detected from the receipt.
The exact imported code state cannot be reconstructed from the receipt alone.
findings.recommended_action: For the next family, stage outputs in a creation-exclusive directory, hash every output and the complete relevant code/dependency/runtime set, atomically finalize a receipt, and provide a no-registry dry-run verification mode.

findings.title: Concurrent execution can leave unreceipted runs and the JSONL registry lacks an inter-process lock
evidence: The 151330Z directory contains one experiment's five run files, one prediction, and one model spec but has no inventory or run receipt.
Both processes can pass the empty-registry check before either appends; AppendOnlyExperimentRegistry performs read-then-append without a file lock.
The canonical chain happened to remain valid at 12 records, but the filesystem contains ambiguous noncanonical evidence.
risks: Two simultaneous writers could append incompatible sequence/hash heads or leave partial artifact trees.
findings.recommended_action: Add an inter-process batch/registry lock, write failed-run receipts, and quarantine or explicitly index incomplete attempts without deleting evidence silently.
findings.implementation_status: deferred and transparently registered as a deferred cleanup item

findings.title: Audit isolation is semantically strong for modeling but not literally byte-isolated
evidence: load_development_source uses pandas.read_csv(nrows=3213), and all saved OOF decision dates precede 2023-07-03; split inspection found zero chronological/purge violations across 12 manifests.
The development run nevertheless opens a single CSV whose filename and contents extend through 2026 and hashes the entire file at receipt creation.
qa_flags audit_isolated=true and run_receipt historical_audit_accessed=false are self-asserted rather than enforced by a physically separate protected partition.
risks: There is no evidence that audit outcomes influenced the model, but the literal no-load claim is stronger than the implementation proves.
findings.recommended_action: Materialize and hash a development-only source object before experimentation; keep audit bytes behind a separate loader/claim boundary and derive the receipt from the protected manifest rather than reading the combined file.

findings.title: The registry is structurally valid but incomplete as a self-contained experiment-return ledger
evidence: All 12 registry lines validate their sequence, previous hash, canonical record hash, unique ID, and fixed family budget.
train_metrics contains selection labels and chosen calibration/margins but no numeric inner-fold candidate scores.
The registry stores aggregate economics, not aligned per-observation trial returns; external prediction files are not hashed by the run receipt.
PBO is computed from three arms separately within each horizon, while DSR declares 12 trials but estimates Sharpe-distribution moments from only the three same-horizon arms.
risks: The trial_return_registry_complete=true gate input is not supported as a self-contained, immutable ledger.
PBO/DSR do not fully represent the horizon/target search and are additionally invalidated by overlapping economic paths.
findings.recommended_action: Persist and receipt-hash numeric inner selection scores and synchronized net-return artifacts for every attempted trial; predefine whether multiple-testing adjustment is within horizon or across the full family.

findings.title: The initial hypothesis card controls the budget but does not fully freeze the executable specification
evidence: The card fixes three arm names, four horizons, a 12-trial budget, calibration choices, and margins.
It does not specify the robust regime window/minimum periods, exact feature membership, logistic C/seed, fold minimum sizes, bootstrap iterations/block lengths, or cost/benchmark formulas.
The executable code and its hash appear in the post-run receipt rather than a separately time-anchored pre-run freeze.
risks: The batch is budget-controlled, but the label preregistered overstates how many implementation degrees of freedom were independently frozen before evaluation.
findings.recommended_action: In the next card, include or hash an exact executable config covering transforms, features, model, split geometry, calibration, costs, benchmarks, uncertainty, and promotion criteria before any run starts.

findings.title: MT5 evidence is historical V3 signal replay, not new-candidate or inference parity
evidence: No new candidate was frozen, so no new MT5 run was authorized or produced.
Existing artifacts/mt5 evidence is labeled historical_holdout_v1_previously_revealed_signal_replay and uses Open Prices Only; real-tick archives and native MQL5 inference are explicitly absent.
tests/test_mt5_parity.py compares build_mt5_signal_schedule to replay_mt5_schedule, which validates and returns a copy; it does not compare terminal trade/fill records.
risks: Calling the unit test Python-to-MT5 trade parity would be unsupported.
findings.recommended_action: Retain the narrow deterministic schedule-contract claim. For any future frozen candidate, reconcile exported signals, MT5 orders, fills, exits, costs, and timestamps row by row and archive real-tick evidence when available.
findings.implementation_status: implemented as a limitation; terminal parity remains deferred

findings.title: Exposure classification and absence of confirmation are correctly disclosed
evidence: The baseline freeze records V3 fold five ending in June 2023 and its selection use.
The data availability manifest labels 2022 through H1 2023 development_reused_previously_exposed.
2023-07-03 onward is consistently labeled historical_audit_previously_revealed.
No confirmation, candidate-freeze claim, historical-audit claim, or future-OOS artifact exists for the new batch.
risks: Only future, never-inspected data can supply genuine confirmation.
findings.recommended_action: Preserve these labels and do not relabel any historical interval as locked or confirmation.

hurst_ablation_conclusion.evidence: No-Hurst is numerically best at H1 and H10; robust Hurst is numerically best at H5 and H20; every arm-horizon interval includes chance and every trial is rejected.

Broker/session metadata is reconstructed and cross-broker provenance is incomplete.
Registered multi-day economics, PBO, and DSR are invalid as promotion evidence.
No new-candidate MT5 or real-tick/native-inference parity evidence exists.

recommendation_reason: The negative development conclusion is supported, but P0 economic/execution defects and P1 immutability, concurrency, preregistration, and audit-isolation gaps prevent release of the protocol as complete and prevent any model candidate release.
